title: Run, Rack, Rise

scaling: Run: 500/400 m Row or 15/12 cal bike instead of 400 m

stimulus: A steady triplet with three rounds that should each take about 4 min. The run sets the pace, the squats burn your legs, and the burpees keep your heart rate high. Stay smooth and don't sprint the first run.
strategy: Run the first 400 m at about 80%, not a sprint.
Break squats early: 8-7 in round one, then adjust.
Keep a steady burpee rhythm. Aim for about 4 min per round.

title: Pull Strong, Jump High

scaling: Pull-ups: use jumping pull-ups or ring rows with a slow lowering. Metcon: regular pull-ups or 8 ring rows.

stimulus: Part A is about clean, controlled pulling and single-leg strength, so keep every rep crisp. Part B is a steady, moderate-to-hard grind. Aim for unbroken pull-up sets early and don't let the wall balls pile up.
strategy: Part A: stop each set 1 rep before form breaks.
Part B: split wall balls 6-6 from round one.
Step down from the box and keep a smooth, even rhythm.

title: Every Five Engine

scaling: Cut the cals to 10/8 on bike and 9/7 on row.

strategy: Bike at a pace you could hold for 10 min, not 1.
Row with long, smooth strokes. Save your grip for the rope.
Break sit-ups early: 10-10 or 8-6-6. Never go to failure.
